limitations: Ledger finality is simulated and is not a live-IOTA result.
Services communicate over a same-host Docker bridge.
Each service uses one application worker.
Historical Shimmer measurements must be reported separately.

measurement_definitions.e2e_ns: Gateway A immediately before sending the SAC request through successful verification of Gateway B key confirmation
measurement_definitions.gateway_crypto_full_ns: Cumulative gateway authorization verification, ML-KEM, HKDF, and MAC processing
measurement_definitions.ledger_enqueue_ns: Post-usability submission to the ledger adapter; excluded from e2e_ns
measurement_definitions.ledger_final_ns: Adapter-side submission-to-confirmation interval; simulated in these Docker experiments
